summary: Learn manufacturing cost reduction and lean accounting with practical tools, dashboards, and exercises. Build savings plans and reporting with confidence.
lede: Manufacturing cost reduction training helps manufacturing professionals connect operational waste with cost data and financial reporting. Designed for people involved in plant costs, operational KPIs, or performance reporting, it supports practical cost-reduction planning through value stream mapping, Standard Costing and variance analysis, activity-based costing and cost-driver analysis, and measures such as Overall Equipment Effectiveness, scrap, and rework. Learners also build dashboards and reporting packs to guide decisions across production and finance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with manufacturing costs, operational KPIs, or plant performance reporting and need a more practical way to reduce cost. It is especially relevant if you influence production, finance, quality, inventory, or continuous improvement decisions. Manufacturing Controllers who track plant cost performance and variance. Plant Accountants who build cost reports and monthly close analysis. Cost Accountants who trace overhead and product family costs. Production Managers who need cost reduction plans for operations. Continuous Improvement Leads who link lean actions to savings. Operations Analysts who monitor OEE, scrap, and throughput. Finance Managers who review manufacturing margin and budget control. Lean Manufacturing Managers who coordinate waste reduction initiatives. Supply Chain Analysts who support inventory and replenishment decisions. Quality Managers who reduce cost of poor quality and rework.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop, a spreadsheet tool such as Microsoft Excel, and any non-confidential cost or production data you can share in exercises. Prior knowledge of standard manufacturing reports, cost elements, and basic KPI tracking will help you move faster through the workshops.
